text:
sarah: Heads up — while triaging partner ingestion logs I found a sealed blob that looks like a KMS-wrapped secret leaked in a partner log dump. not sharing full blob here, but ciphertext id: CIPHERTEXT_9f3a. can we triage and coordinate rotation?
ajay: on it. can you paste the ciphertext id + any hint of the key resource? we need to confirm which cryptoKey wrapped it.
sarah: ciphertext: CIPHERTEXT_9f3a, hint: key resource looks like projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/partner-ring/cryptoKeys/ingest-key (may be outdated).
marco: if that's the key, plan is: 1) restrict decrypt perms (cryptoKeyDecrypter) -> narrow service accounts, 2) create new key version/new key and rewrap secrets, 3) rotate Vault transit config to new key id, 4) enable audit export and increase retention.
elaine: agree. also we should enable Cloud KMS admin audit logs and export to BigQuery for 90 days so we can trace unwrapping attempts. ops-oncall, can you schedule the rotation window?
ops-oncall: I can do a midnight/02:00 UTC window tonight. prefer off-peak. need sign-off from security + PM. also will create a runbook and ephemeral key plan.
security-bot: :warning: Incident created: INC-3129 — potential credential leak (auto-classifier: high). Assigned to eng-security oncall.
ajay: preflight commands I'll run:```bash
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy ingest-key --keyring=partner-ring --location=global --project=redwood-prod
gcloud kms decrypt --ciphertext-file=- --location=global --keyring=partner-ring --key=ingest-key < sample_ciphertxt.bin || true
```Want to confirm bindings before changing RBAC.
marco: RBAC proposal: remove broad members, add only "serviceAccount:nexus-ingest-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com" with roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter on the specific key. Then introduce a conditional binding for staging vs prod if partner needs cross-env access.
elaine: we should also create a temporary vault-transit key in Vault (local) so we can rewrap without losing availability. rotor job sequence: 1) create new KMS key, 2) create new key version, 3) run rewrap job to new key (canary subset), 4) verify app decrypts, 5) flip vault config, 6) revoke old key versions.
sarah: notifying partner now with minimal details + ask them to rotate any app credentials they might have ingested from logs. CC security + legal.
ops-oncall: assigning tasks: ajay -> list bindings + run rewrap canary script; marco -> prepare IAM change PR and rollback; elaine -> enable audit export + retention; sarah -> partner comms; I'll own scheduling + runbook ops. target window: 02:00 UTC tonight.
ajay: copying the canary rewrap command I'll run (dry-run first):```bash
# dry-run rewrap (project-level sample)
gcloud kms keys versions create --key=ingest-key --keyring=partner-ring --location=global --project=redwood-prod --purpose=encryption
# rewrap (actual)
gcloud kms keys versions create --key=ingest-key --keyring=partner-ring --location=global --project=redwood-prod --purpose=encryption && \
  python tools/rewrap.py --ciphertext-id CIPHERTEXT_9f3a --target-key projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/partner-ring/cryptoKeys/ingest-key-v2
```will post logs to the runbook channel.
marco: one more ask — add conditional IAM to only allow decrypt when request.auth.requestedPrincipal == "serviceAccount:nexus-ingest-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com". if GCP condition grammar blocks, fallback to scoped key per environment.
elaine: ops, also enable KMS Admin audit logs and set sink to bq: redwood_audit.kms_logs with 90d retention. need billing approval?
ops-oncall: billing ok for short-term. will create sink and verify logs within 15m of enabling.
sarah: OK — proceeding with partner notification. adding link to minimal incident summary in the runbook. INC-3129 in subject.
ajay: I'll kick off preflight in ~5m and report findings here. if preflight shows other ciphertexts linked to same key, we escalate to full rotation immediately.
security-bot: :lock: Action checklist: [x] incident created INC-3129, [ ] RBAC PR, [ ] rewrap canary, [ ] audit export, [ ] partner rotation confirmation.
marco: thanks team. once RBAC PR is ready tag @security-review for quick approval. aim to have RBAC PR merged before rotation window.
elaine: will update on audit export in channel when sink is live.
ops-oncall: confirmed window and runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/INC-3129-rotor (will update with timestamps).
sarah: thanks all — keep updates short in this thread.
ajay: will post final status in ~20m.
